material.acceptance_criteria: a CI job runs N ticks and reports tick time percentiles in the log; a budget overrun is logged with its tick number.
material.description: Record per-tick time, queue depth and mod reload latency as counters the server exposes in its log and to the LSP. New module in rust/crates/server.
material.resolution: Fixed 64-bucket tick histogram and percentile reporter in budget.rs, started from run(); queue depth via a counter; tick-overrun line with tick number; --ticks and --tick-budget-us flags; CI job checks tick-time and tick-overrun lines. Argument order of tick-overrun not traced by verifier.
material.subject: Per-tick budget and profiling counters on the server
